title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’ve been arguing with someone who calls him an org guy. I think he’s much better than that. Though only 318 ABs, org guys don’t hit .300 in the majors. Might only be a part-time player (super utility who you can plug to patch injuries) but the kid screams “ballplayer” - instincts, feel, mentality - and being that super-util can be very valuable, no?
Or, perhaps a better question, is that an alright “take”?
There’s a spot in the big leagues for versatile defenders with bat to ball skills. Need more impact to be a regular but your take is good
Thanks, just wanted to bounce it off someone.
